mg.polish: Polish in little circles to make it shine!

tut.market: Hi, I'm Rory! Let's find some treasure. Tap the dirty mug!
tut.toWorkshop: Great find! Now let's clean it up in the workshop.
tut.scrub: Rub your finger over the mug to scrub off the grime!
tut.polish: Now polish in little circles. Watch it sparkle!
tut.reveal: WOW! Look at that! Drag the slider to compare.
tut.sell: A customer! Set a price with the slider, then tap Sell!
tut.close: You made your first sale! Close up shop for today.
tut.summary: Here's how your day went. Tomorrow: more markets, more treasure!
daily.title: Daily Fix
daily.reward: +{n} coins for every new star · Streak: {streak} days
daily.noImprove: No new stars this time. Try again!
complete.title: You've flipped it all!
complete.body: You own the Grand Emporium and found every single item in the Sticker Book. There is no more new stuff to unlock: you've seen everything Thrift Flip has! You can keep playing as long as you like to beat your best profit.
hub.title: Grow your shop
decor.title: Decorations
mg.rep.screws: Hold the screwdriver on each screw to take it out.
mg.rep.twist: Twist the back round and round to unscrew it.
mg.rep.cover: Lift the cover off! (tap or drag it away)
mg.rep.hood: Lift the hood! (tap or drag it up)
mg.rep.swapOut: Pull out the broken part (marked !) and drop it in the bin.
mg.rep.swapIn: Put the new part into its place.
mg.rep.pourOil: Hold on the cap to pour in oil. Let go in the green!
mg.rep.pourCoolant: Hold on the cap to pour in coolant. Let go in the green!
mg.fix: Open it up and fix what's broken inside.
mg.rep.dust: Hold the air can on each dust bunny to blow it away.
mg.rep.paste: Hold on the CPU to squeeze on thermal paste. Let go in the green: a pea-sized dot!
mg.rep.drain: Hold on the drain plug to let the old oil run out.
mg.rep.boltsOut: Hold the spanner on each bolt to undo it.
mg.rep.boltsIn: Hold the spanner on each bolt to tighten it.
mg.rep.hoistOut: Drag the old engine up and out on the hoist!
mg.rep.hoistIn: Lower the new engine down into the bay.
mg.rep.cables: Plug each cable into the socket with the same label and shape.
mg.rep.hoses: Push each hose onto the pipe with the same label.
jobs.title: Customer job
mg.rep.heat: Hold the heat gun on the back to soften the glue.
mg.rep.lift: The glue is soft! Pull the back off. (tap or drag it)
mg.rep.pourFuel: Hold on the cap to fill the fuel. Let go in the green!
hub.empireSub: {n} of {total} open · bigger jobs, bigger pay
empire.title: {company}
empire.intro: Save up to open a bigger business. Each one brings new customers with harder, better-paid repairs.
empire.workAtIntro: Pick one of your businesses for today. Each has its own customers.
empire.workAtLater: You already started today. You can switch tomorrow!
bizDesc.reselling: Where it all started: flea market finds.

bizDesc.robotics: Robot arms, drones and robot pets.
name.title: Name your company!
name.sub: Spin the words, or type your own name.
mg.build: Fit every part, plug everything in, then close it up.
mg.design: Tap a slot, then pick a part. Meet the client's spec!
mg.designOff: Not quite: swap parts until every gauge is green.

mkt.toast.satellite: {company} is beamed to the whole planet!

contract.signed: Signed by {company}! It's in the workshop queue.

mgr.intro: Managers run your businesses while you work elsewhere: today they would make +{n}. Branches multiply what a business makes.
mgr.locked: Reach the top of the ladder ({biz}) to hire managers and open more branches.
mgr.couldEarn: Could make up to {n} a day

world.locked: Reach the top of the ladder ({biz}) to expand abroad.
world.progress: Open an office, then win its flagship contract. {n} of {total} conquered.
world.allWon: {company} runs the whole world! Space is next.
world.opened: Office open in {region}! A flagship contract is waiting at {biz}.

space.locked: Conquer every region on Earth, then reach for space!

prestige.tokens: {company} starts again from a little stall, but stronger: you get {n} prestige tokens for the legacy tree.
prestige.keep: Your company name, the legacy tree and tokens, the catalog, shop decorations, purchases and lifetime stats.
prestige.reset: Coins, level, shop size, businesses, managers, regions, colonies and the Dyson project.

fx.discount: {n}% off businesses, managers, branches, offices and colonies
tablet.homeSub: Your company tablet. Tap an app!
tablet.treeHint: Tap a skill to see what it does. Drag and zoom to look around.
tablet.treeTokens: {n} tokens to spend · {p} prestiges so far. Gold lines join the skills you own.
tablet.owned: Yours for good: it stays after every prestige.
tablet.spaceHint: Tap a planet, moon or the Sun. Drag and zoom to look around.
tablet.spaceCount: {n} of {total} colonies founded. A gold ring means you can found a colony there now.
tablet.spaceLocked: Conquer every Earth region to unlock space.
tablet.sunInfo: Dyson project: {n} of {total} stages built, {pct}% of the Sun harvested.
tablet.founded: {company} has a colony here. In stock: {n}.
tablet.colonyCost: Found a colony here for {n} coins.
gold.skipText: Let days go by. Your managers, colonies and the Dyson project keep working: about {n} coins a day.
gold.skipBusy: Skips work at the start of a day, before you buy anything or take a job.
gold.skipNothing: Days go by, but nothing earns while you are away yet: hire managers (after Rocket Repair) or found colonies first.
gold.earlyText: Get a tool before your shop is big enough for it.
gold.earlyNone: You already have every tool. Bigger shops need no early tools.
gold.earn: Earn Gold Bars by opening businesses, conquering regions, founding colonies, building Dyson stages, perfect contracts, 3-star daily challenges and every prestige.
gold.buyText: Gold Bar packs. You also earn them by playing.
gold.pretend: Playtest store: pretend purchases, no real money. You also earn Gold Bars by playing.
gold.pretendAsk: This is a playtest: no money is paid. Add {n} Gold Bars?
store.gold_small.d: 20 Gold Bars for time skips and early tools.
store.gold_medium.d: 120 Gold Bars for time skips and early tools.
store.gold_large.d: 280 Gold Bars for time skips and early tools.
mg.asm.socketOpen: Lift the socket's lever to open it.
mg.asm.socketPlace: Tap the chip to turn it until its gold mark matches the socket's corner, then drop it in. Never force it: the pins bend!
mg.asm.socketClose: Push the lever back down to lock the chip in.
mg.asm.torqueSnug: Snug each bolt in the order of the numbers (hold the wrench on it).
mg.asm.torqueFinal: Now torque each bolt in order: hold and let go in the green. Too far strips it!
mg.asm.ramLatch: Open both latches of slot A2 (tap them).
mg.asm.ramInsert: Tap the memory stick to turn it so its notch matches the slot, then drag it into A2.
mg.asm.ramPress: Press the stick down firmly until the latches click shut.
mg.asm.header: Fit each little plug onto its pins. LED plugs have a + side: tap to turn them round.
mg.asm.beltRoute: Loop the belt round the pulleys in the order on the routing sticker.
mg.asm.beltTension: Hold the tensioner back so the belt slips onto the last pulley.
mg.asm.servo: Hold + or − to turn the servo horn. Let go right on 90°.
mg.asm.leakPump: Hold the test valve to pressurise the fuel lines up to the line.
mg.asm.leakFind: One fitting is leaking: find the bubbles and hold the wrench on it.
gold.rushText: {tech} has {n} days to go. Finish it right now.
gold.rushNone: Nothing is being researched. Start research in the space program first.
gold.goldenOn: Already on for your next item
gold.brandSub: a big ad campaign (once a day)
gold.shipText: A rocket brings {n} of a colony's material home right away: handy for the next Dyson stage.
gold.shipNone: Found a colony first: then cargo runs can bring its material home.
gold.decorText: Only for Gold Bars, with a bonus for the shop.
fuse.sym.pump: it cranks but won't start (no fuel).
fuse.sym.socket: phones won't charge in the car.
mg.car.obdPlug: Plug the scanner into the OBD-II port under the dashboard.
mg.car.obdRead: The scanner is reading the trouble codes…
mg.car.obdCode: Note the trouble code (it stays pinned), then press OK.
mg.car.plug.unclip: Which cylinder misfires? Check the code, then unclip that coil's connector.
mg.car.plug.pull: Pull the ignition coil up and out.
mg.car.plug.out: Turn the socket anticlockwise (lefty loosey) to unscrew the old plug.
mg.car.plug.gap: Set the new plug's gap: hold the gauge and let go in the green.
mg.car.plug.in: Thread the new plug in clockwise (righty tighty).
mg.car.plug.torque: Torque the plug: hold and let go in the green. Too tight cracks it!
mg.car.plug.refit: Push the coil back down onto the plug.
mg.car.plug.clip: Clip the coil's connector back on.
mg.car.bat.negOff: Undo the NEGATIVE (−, black) clamp first.
mg.car.bat.posOff: Now undo the positive (+, red) clamp.
mg.car.bat.in: Put the new battery in its tray.
mg.car.filter.off: Twist the old oil filter off anticlockwise.
mg.car.filter.oil: Tap the new filter to wipe fresh oil on its rubber seal.
mg.car.filter.place: Put the new filter on its thread.
mg.car.filter.on: Spin it on clockwise until it's hand-tight.
mg.car.fuse.find: Read the complaint and the legend, then tap fuses with the test light.
mg.car.fuse.pull: That one's blown: pull it out with the fuse puller.
mg.car.fuse.fit: Fit a new fuse with the SAME amps (same colour). Never bigger!
mg.car.unplug: Safety first: pop the battery connector off with the spudger.
mg.car.powerLast: Not yet! Plug every other cable in first: power goes on last.
mg.rep.pry: Slide the pick round the edge: tap each clip to pop it.
